c2_accumulated_frame.equation:
c2_accumulated_frame stackpointer p q n m =
    MAYCHANGE [RIP;RSP;RAX;RDI;RSI;RDX;R10;R11;RBX;RBP;R12] ,,
    MAYCHANGE SOME_FLAGS ,,
    MAYCHANGE [memory :> bytes(p,if c2_equal m p q n then n else 0);
               memory :> bytes(word_sub stackpointer (word 32),32)] ,,
    MAYCHANGE [events]

c2_before_cleanup_frame.equation:
c2_before_cleanup_frame stackpointer =
    MAYCHANGE [RIP;RSP;RAX;RDI;RSI;RDX;R10;R11;RBX;RBP;R12] ,,
    MAYCHANGE SOME_FLAGS ,,
    MAYCHANGE [memory :> bytes(word_sub stackpointer (word 32),32)] ,,
    MAYCHANGE [events]

c2_crypto_completed.equation:
c2_crypto_completed lib_file stackpointer p q n m rp wp xp ordinary
    (initial:x86state) a (returned:x86state) <=>
    ?entry:x86state.
      c2_crypto_ready lib_file stackpointer p q n m rp wp xp ordinary initial a entry /\
      bp_assurance_call_post 0x10241840 (word_sub stackpointer (word 32))
        (word 0x22001132) p q n (read events entry) (read memory entry) entry returned

purpose: Proven endpoints and frame/effect predicates for named end-to-end obligations; never assumed caller preconditions
